title: White-Label Weekly Client Reports
tagline: Email every client a branded PDF performance report every Monday, automatically.
description: Every Monday the workflow reads a client roster from Google Sheets and, per client, pulls metrics from HubSpot, Meta Ads and Google Ads, has an LLM write a short performance commentary, renders a branded PDF through PDFShift and sends it by Gmail. Failures are logged to a sheet and alerted in Slack. Meta and Google Ads are optional; their metrics show as 0 if skipped.
patterns: parallel metric sources with graceful degradation
